mapper.select:
/** exceldownload-log-mapper.getExceldownloadLogListCountByParam (엑셀다운로드 사유 목록 갯수) */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT PL.ID, PL.CREATED_AT, PL.IP, PL.LOGIN_TYPE, PL.MANAGER_ID, (CASE WHEN LOGIN_TYPE = 'MANAGER' THEN (SELECT LOGIN_ID FROM OP_MANAGER WHERE PL.MANAGER_ID = USER_ID) WHEN LOGIN_TYPE = 'SELLER' THEN (SELECT LOGIN_ID FROM OP_SELLER WHERE PL.MANAGER_ID = SELLER_ID) ELSE '' END) AS LOGIN_ID, NVL(PL.MANAGER_ID, 0), PL.METHOD, PL.NAME, PL.REASON, PL.TASK, PL.URL, PL.USER_ID FROM OP_PRIVACY_ACCESS_LOG PL WHERE PL.TASK = '엑셀 다운로드'
AND PL.MANAGER_ID = #{adminUserId}
ORDER BY PL.CREATED_AT DESC ) A WHERE 1=1
AND A.LOGIN_ID = (SELECT crypto_enc('normal', #{srchValue},''))
AND A.NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{srchValue} , '%')
AND A.REASON LIKE CONCAT('%', #{srchValue} , '%')
AND A.CREATED_AT >= CONCAT(#{srchStartLogDate}, '000000')
AND A.CREATED_AT <= CONCAT(#{srchEndLogDate}, '235959')

/** exceldownload-log-mapper.getExceldownloadLogListByParam (엑셀다운로드 사유 목록) */ SELECT A.id, A.created_at, A.ip, A.login_type, (CASE WHEN A.login_type = 'MANAGER' THEN crypto_dec('normal', A.login_id, '', 0) WHEN A.login_type = 'SELLER' THEN A.login_id ELSE '' END) AS login_id, A.manager_id, A.method, A.name, A.reason, A.task, A.url, A.user_id, (select label from op_common_code where code_type = 'EXCELDOWNLOAD_REASON_TYPE' and A.reason_type = id) as reason_type, A.hist_cnt FROM (
SELECT PL.id, PL.created_at, PL.ip, PL.login_type, (CASE WHEN login_type = 'MANAGER' THEN (SELECT login_id FROM op_manager WHERE PL.manager_id = USER_ID) WHEN login_type = 'SELLER' THEN (SELECT login_id FROM op_seller WHERE PL.manager_id = SELLER_ID) ELSE '' END) AS LOGIN_ID, NVL(PL.manager_id, 0) AS manager_id, PL.method, PL.name, PL.reason, PL.task, PL.url, PL.user_id, PL.reason_type, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM op_privacy_access_log_hist A WHERE A.privacy_access_log_id = PL.id) AS hist_cnt FROM op_privacy_access_log PL WHERE PL.task = '엑셀 다운로드'
AND PL.manager_id = #{adminUserId}
ORDER BY PL.created_at DESC ) A WHERE 1=1
AND A.login_id = (SELECT crypto_enc('normal', #{srchValue},''))
AND A.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{srchValue} , '%')
AND A.reason LIKE CONCAT('%', #{srchValue} , '%')
AND A.created_at >= CONCAT(#{srchStartLogDate}, '000000')
AND A.created_at <= CONCAT(#{srchEndLogDate}, '235959')

SELECT ID, MANAGER_ID, REASON_TYPE, (select label from op_common_code where code_type = 'EXCELDOWNLOAD_REASON_TYPE' and reason_type = id) as REASON_TYPE_NM, REASON FROM OP_PRIVACY_ACCESS_LOG WHERE 1=1 AND ID = #{id}
